steps.title: Prepare stock solutions and buffers
steps.instruction: Make all reagents listed in the Recipes section at the concentrations and volumes shown, storing each at the temperature indicated (e.g., 100 mg/mL cycloheximide at –20 °C, 1 M DTT at –20 °C, 70 % ethanol, 1 mg/mL ethidium bromide, 10 mM GTP, 1× MOPS buffer, 10 mg/mL puromycin, 0.6 mM puromycin, 2× ribosome dilution buffer, RNA loading dye, RNA sample buffer, 60 % sucrose, 35 % buffered sucrose, 1× TBE buffer).

steps.title: Linearize plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: In a microcentrifuge tube combine 100 µL plasmid DNA (300 ng/µL), 20 µL 10× CutSmart buffer, 20 µL restriction enzyme (400–800 U total), and 60 µL Milli‑Q water; mix by inverting 20×, spin briefly, incubate 4 h at 37 °C, then hold at 4 °C (pause point – store at –20 °C).

steps.title: Run agarose gel to check digest
steps.instruction: Cast a 0.8 % (w/v) agarose gel in 1× TBE: dissolve 0.8 g agarose in 100 mL 1× TBE, heat 1.5 min, cool 10 min, add 5 µL 10 mg/mL ethidium bromide, pour ~70 mL into casting tray, solidify ~1 h, insert combs, cover gel with ~350 mL 1× TBE. Load 5 µL Quick‑Load Purple ladder in first well and 1 µL purified linear plasmid + 1 µL 6× loading dye + 4 µL water (total 6 µL) in another well; run 120 V constant for 30–45 min, image under UV to confirm a single band.

steps.title: Purify linearized plasmid
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL DNA binding buffer to the 200 µL digest, invert 20×, transfer to Zymo‑Spin column, centrifuge 30 s at 16,000 × g, discard flowthrough; wash with 200 µL DNA wash buffer, centrifuge, discard; repeat wash; place column in a fresh 1.7 mL tube, add 30 µL nuclease‑free water directly to the resin, incubate 1 min at RT, centrifuge 1 min at 16,000 × g, collect eluate, store on ice or –20 °C; measure concentration by NanoDrop; confirm integrity by running a second 0.8 % agarose gel as above.

steps.title: Resuspend ARCA cap analog
steps.instruction: Collect the 1 µmol ARCA pellet by a short spin, add 25 µL nuclease‑free water, flick to mix, spin; repeat the flick‑mix‑spin cycle five times total to obtain a 40 mM ARCA stock.

steps.title: In‑vitro transcription of capped mRNA
steps.instruction: On ice assemble a 10 µL T7 transcription reaction: 1 µL linear plasmid (500 ng/µL), 0.5 µL RNase inhibitor, 1 µL 10× T7 buffer, 1 µL 100 mM ATP, 1 µL 100 mM UTP, 1 µL 100 mM CTP, 1 µL 10 mM GTP (not 100 mM), 2 µL 40 mM ARCA, 1 µL T7 RNA polymerase mix, 0.5 µL nuclease‑free water; incubate 2 h at 30 °C, then add 1 µL RNase‑free DNase I, incubate 15 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Optional polyadenylation of RNA
steps.instruction: If poly(A) tails are desired, combine the 11 µL DNase‑treated transcription mix with 5 µL 10× Poly(A) polymerase buffer, 5 µL 10 mM ATP, 1 µL E. coli Poly(A) polymerase, and 28 µL nuclease‑free water; incubate 1 h at 37 °C. If not, add 39 µL water to bring the volume to 50 µL.

steps.title: Purify transcribed RNA
steps.instruction: To each 50 µL RNA sample add 100 µL RNA binding buffer, invert 20×; add 150 µL 100 % ethanol, invert 20×; transfer to Zymo‑Spin IICR column, centrifuge, discard flowthrough; wash with 400 µL RNA prep buffer, centrifuge; wash with 700 µL RNA wash buffer, centrifuge; wash again with 400 µL RNA wash buffer, centrifuge 4 min; place column in a new tube, add 75 µL nuclease‑free water, incubate 1 min, centrifuge to elute; store RNA on ice, measure by NanoDrop, aliquot 3 µL portions, store at –80 °C (pause point).

steps.title: Verify RNA quality on denaturing gel
steps.instruction: Cast a 0.8–1 % (w/v) agarose/formaldehyde gel: dissolve 0.8–1 g agarose in 80 mL water, microwave 1.5 min, cool 2 min, add 10 mL 10× MOPS and 10 mL 37 % formaldehyde, cool 5–10 min, pour 100 mL into tray, solidify ~1 h in the dark. Prepare samples: 500 ng RNA + 1 µL 1 mg/mL EtBr + 1 µL loading dye + 5 µL fresh RNA sample buffer + water to 15 µL; prepare ladder similarly with 1 µL Millennium RNA marker, 1 µL EtBr, 1 µL loading dye, 3 µL sample buffer, 4 µL water. Heat 70 °C 5 min, ice 2 min. Load samples and ladder, run at 60 V (5–10 V/cm) for 3–4 h (or until dye front 2 cm from bottom), image under UV to confirm a single band (polyadenylated RNA runs ~100–200 nt heavier).

steps.title: Dilute normalizing control mRNA
steps.instruction: Calculate the mass for 3 nM in 10 µL using the mRNA sequence; dilute purified mRNA so that 2 µL contains that mass, giving a working concentration of 15 fmol/µL; keep on ice.

steps.title: Translate normalizing control mRNA
steps.instruction: In a PCR tube set up a 10 µL reaction: 2 µL 15 fmol/µL control mRNA, 3 µL Flexi RRL (nuclease‑treated), 0.1 µL 1 mM amino‑acid mix minus Leu, 0.1 µL mix minus Met, 0.2 µL 25 mM Mg(OAc)₂, 0.4 µL 2.5 M KCl, 0.2 µL RNase inhibitor, 4 µL nuclease‑free water; incubate 15 min at 30 °C, then place on ice and add 4 µL 5 mg/mL cycloheximide (final 1.43 mg/mL), invert 20×, spin briefly (volume now 14 µL).

steps.title: Translate experimental mRNA
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10 µL reaction identical to the control (using 2 µL 15 fmol/µL experimental mRNA). Incubate 15 min at 30 °C, place on ice, then add 2 µL either nuclease‑free water (no‑puromycin) or 0.6 mM puromycin (final 0.1 mM); invert 20×, spin, incubate puromycin‑treated samples 30 min at 30 °C, keep water‑treated samples on ice. Finally add 2 µL 10 mg/mL cycloheximide (final 1.43 mg/mL) to all, invert 20×, spin (volume now 14 µL).

steps.title: Combine control and experimental translations
steps.instruction: Mix 14 µL of the control translation reaction with 14 µL of the corresponding experimental reaction (puromycin‑treated or water‑treated) to obtain 28 µL total; keep on ice.

steps.title: Dilute combined sample with ribosome buffer
steps.instruction: Add 28 µL ice‑cold 2× ribosome dilution buffer (contains freshly added CHX and DTT) to each 28 µL combined sample, yielding 56 µL; invert 20×, spin briefly, keep on ice.

steps.title: Prepare sucrose cushions
steps.instruction: Label 7 mm × 20 mm polycarbonate tubes, mark a spot on the rim, place tubes in a chilled ice bucket. Add 130 µL ice‑cold 35 % (w/v) buffered sucrose (with fresh CHX and DTT) to the bottom of each tube.

steps.title: Layer sample onto sucrose cushion
steps.instruction: Very carefully overlay the 56 µL diluted translation sample onto the 130 µL sucrose cushion without disturbing the interface.

steps.title: Ultracentrifuge ribosome pellets
steps.instruction: Place tubes in the pre‑cooled S100‑AT3 rotor (marked side facing outward), insert rotor into the pre‑cooled Sorvall Discovery M120 SE ultracentrifuge, centrifuge at 50,000 × g for 1 h at 4 °C (acceleration 9, deceleration 5). After run, remove tubes on ice, discard supernatant without disturbing the glossy pellet located at the marked side of the tube.

steps.title: Extract ribosome‑bound RNA with TRIzol
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL TRIzol to a new 1.7 mL tube. Add 100 µL TRIzol to the pellet in the 7 mm tube, pipet up/down 20×, transfer this 100 µL to the tube (now 300 µL). Add another 200 µL TRIzol to the 7 mm tube, pipet 10×, transfer 200 µL to the tube (total 500 µL). Mix end‑over‑end at room temperature for 15 min at 15 rpm, spin briefly, and store the TRIzol suspension at –80 °C.

steps.title: Phase separation and RNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Thaw TRIzol samples at RT, add 100 µL chloroform, vortex 1 min, centrifuge 15 min at 12,000 × g, 4 °C. Transfer the top 200 µL aqueous phase to a new tube, add 1.5 µL 20 mg/mL glycogen, add 500 µL 100 % isopropanol, invert 20×, centrifuge 15 min at 12,000 × g, 4 °C. Aspirate isopropanol leaving ~100 µL, add 600 µL 70 % ethanol, vortex 1 s, centrifuge 15 min at 12,000 × g, 4 °C, aspirate ethanol leaving ~100 µL, air‑dry 2–3 min, add 30 µL nuclease‑free water, incubate 2 min on ice, pipet up/down 20× to resuspend RNA.

steps.title: Reverse transcription to cDNA
steps.instruction: Combine 16 µL RNA with 4 µL 5× iScript Reverse Transcription Supermix, invert 20×, spin. Run thermal cycler: 25 °C 5 min, 46 °C 20 min, 95 °C 1 min, hold 4 °C. Dilute each 20 µL cDNA 1:10 with 180 µL nuclease‑free water, store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR primer mixes
steps.instruction: For each primer pair mix 510 µL nuclease‑free water, 45 µL 10 µM forward primer, 45 µL 10 µM reverse primer to obtain a 1:10 diluted primer solution.

steps.title: Set up RT‑qPCR reactions
steps.instruction: In each 96‑well plate well add 13.5 µL master mix (7.5 µL 2× iTaq SYBR Green Supermix + 6 µL 1:10 diluted primers). Add 1.5 µL of 1:10 diluted cDNA (or 1.5 µL water for no‑template controls). Seal plate with a B‑seal, centrifuge ~30 s, then run on a Bio‑Rad CFX Connect: 95 °C 3 min; 40 × (95 °C 10 s, 60 °C 30 s, plate read); melt curve 65 °C→95 °C increment 0.5 °C 5 s.

description: Validation of protocol This protocol was validated in Scarpitti et al. (2022) Journal of Biological Chemistry , DOI: 10.1016/j.jbc.2022.102660. See Figure 6E and 6F.
